summary: Immix Biopharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten follow-on offering of 11,363,637 common shares at $11.00 per share, grossing $125.0 million and netting $117.5 million before expenses, against a September 28, 2026 Nasdaq close of $11.47 (roughly a 4.1% discount). J.P. Morgan is sole bookrunner, with closing expected September 30, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown off an effective January 22, 2026 Form S-3, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and post-deal overhang.
